summary: Kimi Antonelli carved through the field from 19th on the grid to win at Monza, becoming the first Italian victor on home soil since 1966 and delivering a drive that left paddock observers questioning whether they were witnessing a generational talent. Russell's title bid sustained critical damage during the incident-packed afternoon, with Mercedes' unexpected strength at Monza shifting the championship momentum decisively. Antonelli's win hauled Mercedes into serious contention in the standings while simultaneously exposing vulnerabilities in the campaign's earlier narrative.
